title: VLCCs at a Crossroads
summary: Will changing crude oil trade flows help or hurt VLCCs? In recent years, the oil markets seem to be conspiring against the Very Large Crude Carriers (VLCCs). VLCCs have traditionally been the bellwether of the tanker market.
